note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: CtrlS Chennai Datacenter Park, Ambattur Industrial Estate, Chennai (two buildings, 72 MW IT; launched 25 February 2025)
entries.reason: CtrlS's 25 February 2025 release reports the launch of the park (two datacenter buildings, 72 MW IT load, 230 kV GIS) and its Chennai page offers tours of 'Chennai DC2'. The page links an operator map place, 'CtrlS Datacentre' at 13.107083, 80.1629378 (local ctrls-chennai-operator-linked-gmap.html), which would serve as an operator-linked locator; it lies 566 m south-south-east of the existing CapitaLand DC Chennai Ambattur point (a different operator's campus). Status is the problem: the page's current version is dated 2026-07-28 (dateModified; Internet Archive copy of 1 October 2026 identical), 87 days before 23 October 2026 and so outside the 85-day research window, and no in-window dated CtrlS statement about the Chennai park was found (the 13 August 2026 Chennai blog is market commentary only).
entries.reopen_condition: A dated CtrlS statement (release, blog or a new page version bounded by an archive copy) on or after 30 July 2026 that the Chennai park or one of its buildings is operating; then admit with the operator-linked point as a campus locator.

entries.candidate: STT GDC India Ambattur campus, Red Hills Road, Kallikuppam, Chennai (STT Chennai 2 and 3 operating; STT Chennai 4 / IDC 4 under development)
entries.reason: An official locator is ready: SEIAA Tamil Nadu's EC amendment EC25C3803TN5240625A of 19 December 2025 (file 12753, SIA/TN/INFRA2/551858/2025), published by STT on its India compliance page (local stt-ec-chennai-ambattur.pdf), reproduces the 2019 EC's seven GPS vertices for the campus at T.S. No. 2/1, Block 11, Korattur village and T.S. No. 1/1, Block 2, Menambedu village, and lists IDC buildings 1, 2 and 4. But the newest dated status record, the half-yearly EC compliance report for October 2025 to March 2026, gives a submission date of 4 July 2026 (local stt-chennai-ambattur-hycr-oct25-mar26.pdf), 111 days before 23 October 2026; STT's Chennai location page, which says STT Chennai 4 'is under development', is undated and carries no modification date, and STT's newsroom has no in-window Chennai item. The EC is addressed to a site e-mail contact that is not copied.
entries.reopen_condition: STT's April-September 2026 half-yearly compliance report (due by 1 December 2026) or another dated in-window STT or SEIAA record of the campus's operation or of IDC 4 works; then admit the campus (one project) with the EC polygon centroid as the locator after recomputing it.

entries.candidate: CtrlS Chandanvelly AI-ready datacenter park, Hyderabad (status refresh of the existing imported record)
entries.reason: CtrlS's Hyderabad page (version 2026-09-22, bounded by Internet Archive copies of 29 August and 1 October 2026) says 'We're building two of India's largest AI-ready datacenter campuses' and lists the Chandanvalley campus (40 acres, over 700 MW scalable to 1.4 GW, '400 KV GIS with Approved Sanction Power of 700 MVA'). The sentence is a section heading for capacity marketing and names no physical work stage, contractor, building or date of works; the deploy-AI page (published 29 July 2026) likewise says only that CtrlS is 'building GW-scale datacenter campuses across Hyderabad, Mumbai, Chennai ...'. It is not treated as evidence of physical construction, and refreshing the record as announced could understate whatever stage has been reached.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated CtrlS, TGIIC, TGPCB or Telangana government record of physical works (site preparation, foundations, building construction) at the Chandanvelly campus, or a dated operator statement explicitly reporting construction underway there.

entries.candidate: CtrlS Future City datacenter campus (36 acres, up to 750 MW; named 'Pharmacity' campus in the July 2026 page version), Hyderabad
entries.reason: Named on CtrlS's Hyderabad page version of 22 September 2026 as one of two campuses the operator is 'building'. No address, survey number, village or map link is given, so there is no locator; 'Future City' (Bharat Future City) is a large planned township, not a plot.
entries.reopen_condition: An operator-linked map point, TGIIC/FCDA allotment with survey numbers and a georeferenced plan, or an EC with coordinates for the CtrlS Future City campus.

entries.candidate: CtrlS Hyderabad DC1 (PTDC, HITEC City / Madhapur)
entries.reason: Covered by the same 24 September 2026 statement that CtrlS's three Hyderabad datacenters are in service, but it is a separate site from the Financial District facility added here. The only location given is the registered office (Pioneer Towers, Plot 16, Software Units Layout, Madhapur), a head-office address that cannot be used as a locator; the operator's single Hyderabad map link resolves to the Financial District facility instead.
entries.reopen_condition: An operator-linked map point or official address point identified as the PTDC/DC1 datacenter building.

entries.candidate: Sify datacenters in Hyderabad (Survey No. 115/1, Financial District, Nanakramguda; 14.4 MW, two further towers planned), Bengaluru (4.82 MW), Chennai 01 (Tidel Park, 3.58 MW) and Kolkata (DLF IT Park 1, New Town, 1.08 MW)
entries.reason: Sify's city pages in their versions of 29 September 2026 (article:modified_time; Wayback CDX listings show copies of 28 July 2026 for Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai and 11 July 2026 for Bengaluru, all before the modification, and copies of 1 October 2026 for each page; only the Chennai copies were fetched) present each facility as in service, which would be in-window operating observations. None has a usable point: the pages embed Google map iframes that give only a viewport centre and a place ID (the embed path is robots-disallowed and a cid lookup returns no coordinates), and the street addresses were not geocoded from an admissible source. Sify's Hyderabad facility is in the same Financial District area as the CtrlS facility added here and must be screened against it.
entries.reopen_condition: An operator-linked map short link or official address point/parcel for each facility; the page versions of 29 September 2026 stay in the 90-day window until 28 December 2026 (85-day research window: 23 December).

entries.candidate: Nxtra by Airtel Bengaluru cluster (Whitefield and Hoskote; four facilities of 5.4, 14, 6 and 20 MW), and Nxtra Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Bhubaneswar pages
entries.reason: The Bengaluru page's version of 15 September 2026 lists four facilities by IT power only, with no names, addresses or map links; the Chennai, Hyderabad and Kolkata-Bhubaneswar pages were last modified on 31 March 2026, outside the window. The nxtra.in sitemap carries no dates and no dated Nxtra statement was found.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Nxtra or Airtel statement naming a facility and its status, plus an operator-linked or official locator.

entries.candidate: STT GDC India STT Kolkata 2 (Silicon Valley Hub, New Town), STT Bengaluru 3 (Whitefield), STT Chennai 7 (SIPCOT Siruseri) and STT Hyderabad 1 (HITEC City)

entries.candidate: Amazon data centre groundbreaking at Bharat Future City, Ranga Reddy district, Telangana
entries.reason: Invest Telangana's release (datePublished 2026-07-15, modified 2026-09-28; local telangana-amazon-dc-groundbreaking.html) reports the Chief Minister's participation in the groundbreaking ceremony of Amazon's data centre in Bharat Future City. 15 July 2026 is 100 days before 23 October 2026 (outside the window); a ceremony does not establish a physical work stage, and no village, survey number or plot is given.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window AWS, Telangana or regulator record of the Bharat Future City data centre with a parcel or coordinate locator.

entries.candidate: TCS HyperVault 1 GW AI data centre campus, Hyderabad (existing imported record)
entries.reason: Invest Telangana's release of 5 September 2026 ('TCS HyperVault to Build Rs 70,000 Crore, 1 GW AI Data Centre Campus in Hyderabad', 250 acres) (local telangana-tcs-hypervault-release.html) is a primary government record of the announcement, but it is older than the existing record's 9 September 2026 observation, so it cannot refresh it; it names only Hyderabad and gives no survey numbers, village or plot for a locator.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated primary TCS, Telangana or regulator record after 9 September 2026 reporting a newer status, or a parcel-level locator (locator replacement still needs a separate geometry review).

entries.candidate: CtrlS Kolkata New Town campus later phases (to over 60 MW IT)
entries.reason: CtrlS's 16 October 2026 article says the Kolkata facility has '16 MW of live capacity, scaling to over 60 MW'; the four-phase, over-60 MW plan dates from CtrlS's 27 June 2024 release. The sentence is a capacity forecast for the existing campus, already recorded as context on the Kolkata-DC1 project, and does not name or date a distinct next phase.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated CtrlS or WBHIDCO record naming a second Kolkata building or phase (for example Kolkata-DC2) with its own status; add it as a project reusing the campus locator.
